u0: Initial state: the blocking ball is still on the cell in front of the locked door, so the door cannot be opened yet. Objective: clear the blocker first by picking up the ball and dropping it in a non-blocking cell. If the matching key is already held, drop it first so the ball can be picked up; do not keep the key before the ball has been moved.
u1: Blocker-cleared state: the ball is no longer on the door-front cell, though it may still be carried. Next objective: secure the matching door key while keeping the blocker cell clear. If carrying the ball, drop it in a safe, non-blocking spot before picking up the key. If the ball is dropped back in front of the door, blocker_moved becomes false and the ball must be moved again.
u2: Key-acquired state: the blocker has been moved and the matching key has been acquired at least once, but the door is still closed and the target box is not held. Next objective: open the door with the matching key. If the key has been dropped or lost before opening, retrieve it first; dropping it while the door remains closed triggers key_lost. Also ensure the ball has not been returned to the door-front cell.
u3: Door-opened state: the door has been unlocked and opened, and the target box has not yet been picked up. Next objective: enter the box room and pick up the mission-designated box. If still carrying the key, drop it in a safe cell to free the hands; when the door remains open, dropping the key does not trigger key_lost. If the door was toggled shut or the path is blocked, reopen or clear it first.
u4: Terminal success state: the mission-designated box has been picked up, target_picked_up is true, and the episode ends immediately. No further subtask remains; this is the absorbing final state reached only after completing the mission.
